name: Grendel-GS
definition: An out-of-core and distributed optimization method that partitions the Gaussian list across multiple GPUs, where each GPU renders its own subset of Gaussians and combines the results via inter-GPU communication at partition boundaries.
summary: Grendel-GS is a distributed optimization method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that partitions Gaussians across multiple GPUs to handle scenes exceeding single-GPU memory capacity.
